dct_description_sm: This is spatial data from the 2021 Canadian Census of Population for the Regional Municipality of Durham, originally published by Statistics Canada. This data contains thematic data about employment attributes, reported for males and females, for each of the Region’s census Dissemination Areas (DA).
dct_title_s: 2021 Census - Durham Region Employment By Sex
schema_provider_s: City of Pickering Open Data Portal
